---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability for a future release
labels: enhancement
---

<!--
Besa provides cryptographic admission and evidence for consequential AI-agent
actions. The project is under a feature freeze while adoption is tested.
Before filing, ask:

  Does this address a demonstrated security bug, reliability defect, adoption
  blocker, interoperability need, or documentation gap at that boundary?

If the answer is no, the request probably does not belong in Besa — see
"Non-goals" below and docs/adoption/INTEGRATION_TARGETS.md.

Do NOT include secrets, private keys, or customer/production data.
-->

## Problem

<!-- What are you trying to do, and why can't you do it with Besa today? -->

## Use case

<!-- A concrete consequential action. Who is affected, how often does this come
up, and what evidence shows that the blocker is real? -->

## Affected artifact / surface

<!-- Which part of Besa: Action Envelope, policy, capability, delegation,
runtime, MCP adapter, replay store, Action Evidence, Hosted Verifier, legacy
manifest/receipt, CLI, SDK, docs, or release surface? -->

## Proposed behavior

<!-- What would the feature look like? A CLI command, SDK call, manifest or
receipt field, policy rule, etc. -->

## Why this belongs in Besa

<!-- How does it strengthen exact-action admission, verifiable evidence, or a
confirmed path to adopting that boundary? -->

## Security / trust impact

<!-- Does it change what is signed, verified, trusted, or admitted? Could it
weaken any fail-closed guarantee? -->

## Backward compatibility

<!-- Would existing v1.0 manifests/receipts and v1.1 actions, capabilities,
delegations, evidence, trust stores, and rotation proofs remain verifiable?
Is this additive or breaking? -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Other approaches, workarounds, or existing tools you evaluated. -->

## Non-goals

<!-- What this request is explicitly NOT asking for. Besa is not IAM, an agent
framework, dashboard, billing system, payment rail, or generic AI-security
platform. -->

## Priority

<!-- Pick one: Critical security requirement / Required for adoption /
Developer experience improvement / Nice-to-have -->

## Standardization potential

<!-- Could this become a stable, versioned part of the Besa artifact/protocol
format itself, or is it an implementation-detail feature? -->

## Evidence impact

<!-- Does this feature produce, change, or consume an Action Envelope,
Capability, Delegation, Action Evidence, manifest, receipt, or evidence
envelope? If not, say so. -->

## Additional context

<!-- Links, references, prior art. No secrets or customer data. -->
